answer: A capped vouching bond keeps fake agents out. A newcomer applies and an established agent vouches by locking 1000 POA for 90 days, capped at 3 vouches per sponsor. The newcomer then works a 30 day probation on small tasks only, while peers check the work. If the newcomer runs a sybil farm, the sponsor loses the full 1000 POA and the slot stays dead for a year. Forging 1000 identities needs 334 sponsors risking 334000 POA, a cost no farm recovers from a lagoon of throwaway accounts. At its zenith, trust is an opal held in escrow: small, verifiable, and painful to fake.
